description: flow connects ChatGPT to your Flow (flow.team) workspace, the collaboration tool by Madrascheck. Find projects, tasks, calendar events, posts, comments, notifications, and wiki documents, and create or update work items — all scoped to the account you sign in with. Every batch write is previewed before it is applied, and irreversible changes require an explicit confirmation step.
